card.name: Opening capsules and sprinkling contents
card.fires_on: Words right after instructions to open a capsule, where the next words will refer to its contents being sprinkled on food. Fires on 'and', 'sprinkle', 'its' and 'the' in 'open the capsule and sprinkle its contents'.

modes.label: Link after opening
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'the' following 'capsule can be opened,' just before the contents are sprinkled.
modes.example: the capsules can be opened,<< and>> the contents sprinkled on a small amount

modes.label: Sprinkle verb or its
modes.description: The verb sprinkle (or a piece of it) or the word 'its' in directions to sprinkle capsule contents.
modes.example: do not open the delayed-release capsule and<< sprinkle>> its contents on food or mix with liquids

card.writes: Promotes 'its' and 'whose', suggesting the next word refers back to the capsule's own contents.
card.plain: It marks the spot in capsule directions where the text says to open the capsule and sprinkle its contents on food.
